title: Russian Stir Fry
description: A hearty and flavorful dish made with stir-fried cabbage and a crispy herbal twist.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of herbal oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 1 teaspoon of fry spices and 1 teaspoon of Russian dill. Cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chopped cabbage and cook for 5 minutes, until it starts to soften.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of herbal oil and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Stir-fry the cabbage for another 2-3 minutes, until it's tender but still crisp.
